issues: Activated choice (1) is incorrectly encoded as grantActRestriction. It should encode a temporary effect on the selected enemy follower preventing it from attacking during its controller's next turn; implement a dedicated ability such as a targetable cannotAttack/until-next-turn effect.

Activated choice (2) is left as noop. It should encode: the next time 1 or more followers enter your field this turn, choose one of those followers and give it +1/+1; implement support for delayed one-shot triggers for ally follower entry with a one-time buff target selection.

Fanfare is encoded with filter {trait: "iM@S CG"}, but the source says you may put one of the top 3 cards into your EX area with no trait restriction. Change the effect to look at the top 3 cards, choose any 1 to put into your EX area, and bury the rest.

Activated ability cost is incomplete. The source requires '[engage], discard a card'; encode the discard as part of the activated cost instead of as an optionalCost effect so the damage effect is mandatory after paying the cost.

On Evolve is left as noop. It should encode: select up to 1 card in your EX area, deal damage to your leader equal to that card's cost, and make that selected card cost 0 to play this turn; implement support for targeting a card in EX area, using its printed cost as a dynamic damage amount, and granting that specific EX-area card a temporary play-cost reduction to 0.

Activated ability cost is incomplete. The source requires '[engage], discard a card'; encode the discard as part of the activated cost instead of as an optionalCost effect so the damage effect is mandatory after paying the cost.

Fanfare is encoded as choosing up to 1 generic iM@S CG card from the top 3, but the source allows up to 1 Cute, up to 1 Cool, and up to 1 Passion card from among them to be revealed and added to hand. It should encode three independent trait-limited selections from the looked-at cards, then put the rest on the bottom; implement support for multi-pick search with distinct per-trait quotas from a single revealed set.

Activated ability is missing the 'Lesson (2)' cost requirement. It should include the Lesson (2) cost together with [engage]; implement a dedicated cost/condition for Lesson counts if not currently supported.

Cemetery condition is incorrectly encoded as conditionAny(spellchain 7 OR ownCemeteryMin 7). The source requires at least 7 total spells and Onmyoji cards in your cemetery combined. It should be a single combined cemetery-count condition over cards matching spell or trait Onmyoji; implement a cemetery filter count / condition that counts cards by card type and/or trait combination.
